meta.name: content-quality-auditor
meta.description: Use when auditing content quality, E-E-A-T, or publish readiness; runs 80-item CORE-EEAT scoring with veto checks and a fix plan. Not for structural on-page tags/headers — use on-page-seo-auditor; not for domain/citation trust — use domain-authority-auditor. 内容质量/EEAT评分

copy.tagline: 审计内容质量与EEAT评分，生成修复计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统评估内容质量并提升EEAT表现
copy.tagline_en: Audit content quality and EEAT scoring with fix plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic content quality evaluation and EEAT improvement

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 80 项 CORE-EEAT 标准对内容逐项打分，给出通过/部分/不通过，并计算各维度和总分。还会检测关键信任问题，生成改进优先级列表和具体修复步骤。
howto.when: 当你要求审核内容质量、E-E-A-T 或发布就绪度时触发。例如问“这篇可以发布吗”或“质量如何”，或在用内容写作技能后自动推荐。

say.text: 审计这篇产品评测的 CORE-EEAT 质量。
say.note: Claude 会按产品评测权重打分并给出发布建议。

say.text: 对比我的文章和竞争对手的，做质量审计。
say.note: Claude 会同时评估两篇内容并对比得分。

say.text: 检查这篇博客的发布就绪度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scores content against 80 CORE-EEAT criteria (Pass/Partial/Fail), calculates dimension and overall scores, detects critical trust issues, and generates a prioritized fix plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to audit content quality, E-E-A-T, or publish readiness. For example, 'Is this ready to publish?' or 'How good is this?', or after using content-writing skills.

say_en.text: Audit this product review against CORE-EEAT.
say_en.note: Claude scores with product review weights and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Compare my article with competitor's for quality.
say_en.note: Claude evaluates both and compares scores.

say_en.text: Check this blog post for publish readiness.
say_en.note: Claude runs full audit and outputs SHIP/FIX/BLOCK.
